why: A (proposition_6_32 via IsPush/IsStabKernels.push) is about the sign-normalized push-forward orEquivRay^-1 ∘ α(T1) ∘ propagate ∘ α(T0) ∘ orEquivRay, α(T) = stabSign T = (−1)^{dim coker T}; B's Facts.push is the text's map read literally, without α. For the same data they differ by α(T0)α(T1), which depends on s: B does not hold as we read it. Even with the sign, A ⇒ B would need hypotheses B lacks (IsScFredholmSectionTame f, AdmitsBumpFunctions, zero condition on a neighbourhood of [0,1]); B ⇒ A holds only vacuously.
